title: Circuit Breaker Pattern
summary: Fail fast when a dependency is failing, to stop Cascading Failure and give the system time to recover.

title: Transactional Outbox Pattern
summary: Guarantee Dual-Write consistency between the Database and the Message Broker through a local transaction.

title: CAP & Consistency Models
summary: Choose the consistency level per use case when data is replicated across multiple nodes.

title: Load Balancing & Reverse Proxy
summary: Distribute load and eject failing backends with L4/L7 load balancers, health checks and reverse proxies.

title: Message Queues & Streaming Basics
summary: Decouple producers and consumers with a queue or a log, and understand delivery semantics and ordering.

title: Consistent Hashing
summary: Adding or removing a node moves only about 1/N of the keys thanks to a hash ring and virtual nodes, unlike hash mod N.

title: DB Replication & Sharding
summary: Scale reads and tolerate failures with replication, scale writes and capacity with sharding, and understand the anomalies that come with them.

title: Rate Limiting Algorithms
summary: Protect the system and share quotas fairly with token bucket, sliding window and atomic distributed counters.

title: Caching Strategies
summary: Choose a caching strategy and handle invalidation and cache failures to cut latency while staying correct enough.

title: Redis Cache Stampede
summary: Prevent thousands of requests from missing one hot key together and hitting the Database directly when the cache expires.

title: DB Indexing & Storage Engines
summary: Choose B-Tree or LSM-tree and design indexes correctly to trade write cost for read speed.

title: DB Transactions & Isolation Levels
summary: Understand ACID, isolation levels and MVCC, and how to avoid lost update and write skew under concurrent access.

title: API Design (REST)
summary: Design APIs that are easy to use correctly, can evolve and are safe when clients retry.

title: AuthN, AuthZ, OAuth 2.0 & JWT
summary: Distinguish authentication from authorization, use sessions/JWT/OAuth correctly and avoid common security bugs.

title: Idempotency & Retries
summary: Let clients retry safely with idempotency keys, jittered backoff and duplicate handling.

title: Backend Performance & Profiling
summary: Optimize performance with a process of measuring, finding the bottleneck, fixing the right place and measuring again.

title: SQL Query Optimization (Advanced)
summary: Read execution plans, understand join algorithms and write queries that let the planner choose good plans.

title: ORM & Data Access Pitfalls
summary: Use an ORM while keeping control of the SQL: avoid N+1, choose sensible transaction boundaries and projections.

title: Realtime: WebSocket, SSE & Polling
summary: Choose between polling, SSE and WebSocket and understand the cost of persistent connections at scale.

title: NoSQL Data Models & Access-Pattern Design
summary: Choose key-value, document, wide-column or graph and design data around queries instead of normalization.

title: Search Engine: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch
summary: Understand the inverted index, analyzers, BM25 and shards to build text search correctly.

title: Microservices Fundamentals
summary: Know when to split into microservices and when not to, boundaries by business capability and the price you pay.

title: Event-Driven Architecture
summary: Reduce coupling with events, and understand choreography, schemas and the risk of event spaghetti.

title: Saga Pattern
summary: Achieve business consistency across services with a chain of local transactions and compensating steps instead of 2PC.

title: Observability: Logs, Metrics & Tracing
summary: Understand the state of a distributed system through logs, metrics and distributed tracing, and measure reliability with SLOs.

title: Raft Consensus
summary: Get many nodes to agree on one replicated log through a leader, quorum and term-based elections.

title: Kubernetes Fundamentals
summary: Orchestrate containers by declaring the desired state, with probes, resources and Services.

title: Service Mesh & API Gateway
summary: Distinguish a gateway for north-south traffic from a service mesh for east-west traffic, and the price of a mesh.

title: CQRS & Event Sourcing
summary: Separate the write model from the read model and store a sequence of events as the source of truth when it is really needed.

title: AWS IAM Fundamentals
summary: Control who can do what on AWS resources with users, groups, roles and policies following the principle of least privilege.

title: S3 Security & Encryption
summary: Lock down a bucket with Block Public Access, a Bucket Policy and encryption in transit and at rest using SSE-S3, SSE-KMS or SSE-C.

title: S3 Versioning & Replication
summary: Recover overwritten or accidentally deleted objects with Versioning and copy to another bucket/Region with Replication.

title: S3 Storage Classes & Lifecycle
summary: Choose the right storage class and automatically transition/delete objects with Lifecycle to optimize storage cost.

title: S3 Performance Optimization
summary: Increase S3 throughput by spreading prefixes, multipart upload, byte-range fetch and Transfer Acceleration.

title: EC2 Pricing Models
summary: Cut 50–90% of compute cost by combining On-Demand, Savings Plans/Reserved, Spot and Dedicated Host according to workload characteristics.

title: EC2 Security Groups & Networking
summary: Open the right ports with a stateful Security Group and choose ENI, ENA or EFA according to network separation, bandwidth and HPC needs.

title: EC2 Placement Groups
summary: Place instances in a Cluster, Spread or Partition arrangement to optimize network performance or isolate hardware failures.

title: AWS VPC Networking
summary: Build an isolated network on AWS with subnets, NAT, endpoints and connect multiple VPCs with Peering or Transit Gateway.

title: ELB & EC2 Auto Scaling
summary: Combine the right type of load balancer with an Auto Scaling Group to achieve high availability and elasticity with load.

title: RDS & Aurora High Availability
summary: Distinguish Multi-AZ (fault tolerance) from Read Replicas (read scaling) and choose Aurora when you need performance, durability and Global Database.

title: Amazon DynamoDB Design
summary: Design DynamoDB tables around access patterns with a good partition key, suitable capacity, the right kind of index and DAX when caching is needed.

title: Route 53 & CloudFront
summary: Reduce latency and raise global availability with Route 53 DNS routing policies and CloudFront CDN caching.

title: SQS, SNS & EventBridge
summary: Decouple producers from consumers with queues, pub/sub and an event bus so each side scales and fails independently.

title: AWS Lambda Serverless
summary: Run code on events without managing servers, with a clear understanding of Lambda's concurrency, cold starts and limits.

title: AWS Disaster Recovery Strategies
summary: Choose a DR strategy from Backup & Restore to Active/Active based on RTO, RPO and cost.

title: EBS, EFS & FSx Storage
summary: Choose block, file or Instance Store for EC2 by AZ, IOPS and shareability.

title: CloudWatch, CloudTrail & AWS Config
summary: Distinguish performance monitoring, API auditing and configuration tracking for investigation and compliance on AWS.

title: ECS, EKS & Fargate
summary: Choose a container orchestrator (ECS/EKS) and compute (EC2/Fargate), along with how to grant permissions to tasks/pods.

title: API Gateway & Step Functions
summary: Use API Gateway as the front door and Step Functions to orchestrate workflows instead of chains of Lambdas.

title: Amazon Kinesis (Streams, Firehose, Flink)
summary: Choose Kinesis Data Streams, Firehose or Flink for ingesting and processing streaming data.

title: AWS Data Analytics (Glue, Athena, Redshift, EMR)
summary: Build a data lake on S3 and choose Athena, Redshift or EMR for each querying need.

title: CloudFormation & CDK (IaC)
summary: Manage AWS infrastructure with templates and CDK using change sets, drift detection and DeletionPolicy.

title: AWS Organizations, SCP & Control Tower
summary: Govern multiple accounts with OUs, SCP guardrails, Control Tower and IAM Identity Center.

title: AWS Well-Architected Framework
summary: Assess architectures against 6 pillars and balance the trade-offs among them, and also serve as a reasoning frame for exam questions.

title: AWS Security Services (KMS, GuardDuty, WAF, Cognito)
summary: Encrypt with KMS, manage secrets, detect threats and protect web/login on AWS.

title: ElastiCache, DAX & Caching Strategies
summary: Choose Redis or Memcached, cache-aside and write-through, TTLs and the stampede/stale-data traps.

title: Hybrid Connectivity & Migration (VPN, Direct Connect, DMS)
summary: Connect on-prem to AWS with VPN/Direct Connect/Transit Gateway and migrate data with DMS, DataSync and Snowball.

title: AWS CI/CD & Systems Manager
summary: Build pipelines with CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy and operate fleets with Systems Manager.

title: Advanced AWS Networking (Endpoints, PrivateLink, Global Accelerator)
summary: Access services privately, accelerate globally and observe traffic with endpoints, PrivateLink, Global Accelerator and Flow Logs.

title: AWS Database Portfolio: Choosing a DB by Data Model
summary: Choose among RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, Neptune, Timestream and MemoryDB by access pattern.

title: AWS Cost Optimization & FinOps
summary: Observe cost with tags/Cost Explorer, choose Savings Plans/Spot and eliminate waste.

title: AWS for Developers: SDK, X-Ray, STS, Presigned URL
summary: Authenticate with roles, retry/paginate correctly and trace distributed requests with X-Ray.
